params.columns: k UInt64, u0 UInt64, u1 UInt64, u2 UInt64, u3 UInt64
params.insert: INSERT INTO {table} SELECT number + {i} * {rows} AS k, sipHash64(k, {seed}, {t}) AS u0, u0 % 1000 AS u1, k * 7 AS u2, intDiv(k, 3) AS u3 FROM numbers({rows})

description: 40 table(s) on one pool, one Compact part (5 columns, 20 000 rows) per table per minute for 12 minutes under SYSTEM CAS GC STOP; 6 card-driven rounds per minute 10 s apart, the first after the inserts.
